France Boosts Aeronautics and Industry with €670 Million Aid

French President Emmanuel Macron announced €350 million in state support for aeronautics research and innovation during a visit to an Airbus site in Blagnac, near Toulouse. This aid aims to foster research and innovation within the sector. Additionally, special industrial zones will be established to facilitate the construction of new factories. In a separate but related development, Virbac announced an investment of €320 million in France and requested increased government support for future projects.
